neighbours.label: word-study instructions in language teaching (ask students to write words, sort words by pattern)
fire: The worksheet asks students to write each spelling word three times.
In this activity learners sort the words by their vowel sound.
Teachers can ask pupils to define each new vocabulary word in context.
The game requires players to group words by their first letter.
Children are asked to match each word to its picture.
The exercise invites students to rewrite the sentences using synonyms.
Learners arrange the cards by syllable count before reading aloud.
The quiz asks students to spell twenty words from memory.
quiet: The worksheet is printed on both sides of a single page.
In this activity learners walk around the school garden.
Teachers can ask pupils to tidy their desks at the end of the day.
The game requires players to roll two dice each turn.
Children are asked to line up quietly at the door.
The exercise invites students to stretch for five minutes.
Learners arrange the chairs in a circle before the lesson.
The quiz asks students to name twenty capital cities.
